scientific_integrity: All-dimension proof uses finite-group averaging and a four-orbit stabilizer computation. Reproducible finite exact tests supplement, not replace, proof. No claim of independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Canonical real unweighted complete-bipartite edge spaces only; no individual minimizer classification, weighted statement, or formula for the intermediate-p complement norm. Existing K_(2,n) boundary calculation is not claimed as new. Bibliographic priority remains qualified.
title: Sharp two-sided projection constants for complete-bipartite circulation spaces
